description: July 17, 2023Original statement from New Mexico Human Services Department New division leaders bring experience and passion to serve New MexicoSANTA FE – The New Mexico Human Services Department (HSD) today announced the appointment of four directors effective immediately. Carolee Graham has been named director of the Administrative Services Division (ASD). Nick Boukas has been named director of the Behavioral Health Services Division (BHSD) and Acting CEO of the Behavioral Health Collaborative.

title: Cristina Parajon appointed director at Human Services Department
